field_edits.updated_text: Small bony spur anterior to the talus. Small inferior and posterior calcaneal enthesophytes. No acute fracture or focal osseous lesion.

Mild hallux valgus deformity with mild degenerative changes of the 1st metatarsophalangeal (MTP) joint. Mild joint space narrowing of the distal interphalangeal joints. No dislocation. The remaining joint spaces are preserved.

impression:
1. Mild hallux valgus deformity with mild degenerative changes of the 1st metatarsophalangeal joint.
2. Mild joint space narrowing of the distal interphalangeal joints.
3. Small bony spur anterior to the talus.
4. Small inferior and posterior calcaneal enthesophytes.
5. No acute fracture or dislocation.
